description: The bond rule (qou-g8i1, completed: the Markov property applied at an interior GAP, so it covers the BOUND atom word rather than only the disjoint sector) makes the cluster trace a product over its bonds. Any map carrying products to sums then yields a bond functional, whose connected cumulants above order two vanish identically (PairwiseCumulantVanishing). So b3 = 0 is the TRACE's doing, not the assembly's, and qou-edt7's replacement must break the bond rule -- not merely change f or the edge set.

assertions.name: bond_factors_positive_and_distinct
assertions.detail: three positive, pairwise distinct bond factors -- so the pairs are genuinely typed and the vanishing below is not a degeneracy

assertions.name: production_functional_b3_vanishes
assertions.detail: |b3| = 0.0 < 1e-40 at 50 dps -- zero to the limit of the arithmetic, and exactly zero in the Lean

assertions.name: b3_vanishes_for_every_multiplicative_to_additive_f
assertions.detail: all 5 f give b3 = 0, the discontinuous one included -- so 10a's uniqueness step (continuous Cauchy solutions are c*log), recorded as classical and NOT in Lean, is IRRELEVANT here rather than merely unformalised. The discontinuous row's residual is ~1e-29 because this probe truncates its logarithm to 30 digits before the rational scaling -- that floor is the harness's, not the mathematics'; the Lean statement is exact

assertions.name: ame_b3_is_nonzero_so_the_family_is_excluded
assertions.detail: b3 = +1.426222 MeV != 0 instantiates no_traceFunctional_of_b3_ne_zero: the measured binding is not f o (bond-rule trace) for ANY such f -- the whole family at once, not one f at a time

assertions.name: edge_set_is_irrelevant_once_the_trace_factorises
assertions.detail: every edge set gives b3 = 0: the cumulant subtracts exactly the pair terms the product contains, whatever the product ranges over. So the replacement qou-edt7 asks for is not a different edge set either

scope: (b) on bindings of the form f o (bond-rule trace of the atom word), invariant named: the bond rule makes the cluster trace a product over PAIRS, so the connected part above order two has nothing to be built from. (a) on everything else.
caveats: This probe does NOT re-verify the bond rule. qou-g8i1 did, on real Hecke traces (16 nuclei numerically to 4.45e-31, 6 symbolically); here it is the stated premise, exactly as it is in the Lean, which carries it as a hypothesis rather than an axiom.
It refutes no physics and excludes no non-trace carrier. A many-body term sourced from outside the atom-word trace is entirely untouched.
Whether the bond rule extends past the nuclei qou-g8i1 verified it on is open; if it fails at some A, the exclusion lapses there.

The 'discontinuous' f in check 3 is a Q-linear map on the exponent lattice of this finite sample -- a stand-in for a Hamel-basis Cauchy solution, not a construction of one. It shows the conclusion does not use continuity; it is not a claim about pathological solutions in general.

alpha = E0 = m_e/(q0(q0-1)) is derived at working precision (not a pasted decimal) and enters only as an overall scale and cancels from every vanishing claim -- b3 = 0 holds for alpha = 0 too. No accuracy claim is made and none is possible from a quantity that is identically zero.
q0AnchorReason: alpha = E0 = m_e/(q0(q0-1)) is read at the experimental pin via q_at(); the bond factors are evaluated there. It is an overall scale and cancels from every vanishing claim, so the anchor is declared for provenance rather than because a number moves with it.
